summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — STMPA.PA +7%, AAL.L +5%, BESI.AS +5%, ASML.AS +5%, GLEN.L +5%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (AZN.L -8%, EDV.L -7%, ANTO.L -6%, STLAP.PA -6%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: AZN.L (-7.88%) — Phase III CARDIO-TTRansform trial for heart drug Wainua (with Ionis) missed its primary efficacy endpoint, triggering AstraZeneca's worst single-day drop since March 2020. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — large-cap UK pharma/biotech binary-event names are typically excluded since trial readouts are unscheduled, non-technical shocks that momentum/mean-reversion signals can't anticipate pre-open.

top_movers.catalyst: Multi-day AI/data-center re-rating: STM raised 2026 data-center revenue ambition to ~$1B and BofA upgraded to Buy (PT $100) on silicon-photonics/optical-interconnect growth story.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — STM is dual-listed (NYSE: STM / Euronext Paris STMPA.PA); bot likely tracks only the US-listed line for this large-cap semis name, so the EU-EU ticker never enters a tradable universe.
top_movers.suggestion: Add STMPA.PA as a recognized EU counter mapped to the existing STM entity so cross-listing dedup logic includes it in the uk-eu universe instead of silently dropping the European line.

top_movers.catalyst: Sector-wide copper rally (LME copper +2.8% to a 2-week high on dollar weakness) lifted major copper miner AAL.L; JPMorgan also raised its price target to GBX 3,350 same day.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — AAL.L is a large-cap UK diversified miner/commodity name, a sector the uk-eu strategies apparently don't screen, so the move was structurally invisible regardless of size.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a commodities/miners sleeve to the uk-eu universe (AAL.L, RIO.L, GLEN.L) gated on LME copper/iron-ore daily % move >2%, so sector-driven gainers in mining aren't excluded by default.

top_movers.catalyst: Sympathy rally in EU chip-equipment names after Micron's blowout earnings/guidance; JPMorgan hiked PT to €266 and Goldman reiterated Buy post Besi's June 18 investor-day target raise.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — BESI.AS is an Amsterdam-listed semicap-equipment large cap, not a UK/US name. The move was a cross-border sympathy reaction to a US peer's (Micron) earnings, not a name-level signal any single-stock scanner would catch.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a semicap sector-sympathy rule: when Micron/ASML/TSMC beat-and-raise pre/post-market, pull EU peers (BESI.AS, ASM.AS) into a same-day watchlist so uk-eu strategies can react to supply-chain sympathy moves.

top_movers.catalyst: No single-day headline; move capped a multi-day run-up from a wave of analyst PT hikes (Bernstein to €2,623/$2,623, Wells Fargo, BofA, Morgan Stanley) on AI/EUV demand ahead of July 15 Q2 earnings.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ASML.AS is a mega-cap (~$400B) Dutch semi-equipment name; uk-eu strategies likely cap out at mid/large-cap and don't carry a dedicated large-cap tech/semis sleeve, so it's never in the scan set.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a mega-cap EU-semis sleeve (or widen the uk-eu universe's market-cap ceiling) with a pre-earnings analyst-revision trigger (≥3 sell-side PT hikes within 5 sessions) to catch earnings run-ups like this one.

top_movers.catalyst: Sector-wide copper rally (supply squeeze from Strait of Hormuz sulphuric acid disruptions) lifted FTSE miners broadly; no GLEN-specific news.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — GLEN.L falls into UK large-cap commodities/mining, a sector likely excluded from the bot's tradable universe entirely rather than filtered out on a signal.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a UK mining/commodities sector bucket to the universe with a sector-momentum trigger (e.g., ≥3 of 5 FTSE miners up >2% intraday) so broad commodity-driven rallies aren't structurally unreachable.

top_movers.catalyst: No ASM-specific news; move tracks sector-wide AI/memory-capex enthusiasm after SK Hynix's record $26.5B Nasdaq IPO on 2026-07-10 lifted chip-equipment names.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ASM.AS is a Euronext Amsterdam-listed semiconductor-equipment large-cap; the uk-eu universe roster apparently excludes this sector/exchange bucket entirely rather than screening it out on a technical filter.
top_movers.suggestion: Add Euronext Amsterdam semi-equipment peers (ASM.AS, ASML.AS, BESI.AS) to the uk-eu universe sector whitelist so sector-wide AI-capex catalysts (e.g., HBM-supplier IPOs/capex news) can be captured.

top_movers.catalyst: Phase III CARDIO-TTRansform trial for heart drug Wainua (with Ionis) missed its primary efficacy endpoint, triggering AstraZeneca's worst single-day drop since March 2020.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — large-cap UK pharma/biotech binary-event names are typically excluded since trial readouts are unscheduled, non-technical shocks that momentum/mean-reversion signals can't anticipate pre-open.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change — this is an idiosyncratic clinical-trial binary event, not a technical/momentum miss; adding pharma-earnings-style catalyst gating would require a clinical-trial-calendar feed we don't currently ingest.

top_movers.catalyst: No single-day EDV-specific news; move looks tied to a broader July gold-miner rout (Equinox, Alamos down >25% this month) as gold eased off highs and West Africa cost/royalty overhang weighs on sentiment.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — EDV.L is a London-listed frontier-market gold miner (West Africa ops), likely excluded by a materials/commodity-sector filter rather than by market cap, since it's actually a FTSE 100 constituent (~£9.7B).
top_movers.suggestion: Add a narrow gold-mining/materials sleeve (FTSE 100/250 constituents tagged GICS Metals&Mining) so sector-wide commodity-equity gaps of ≥5% can trigger a mean-reversion or momentum signal instead of being filtered out entirely.

top_movers.catalyst: No firm-specific news; LME copper fell toward $6/lb (2-week low) as renewed Iran conflict fears spiked the dollar and hit industrial metals sector-wide.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ANTO.L is an LSE-listed copper mining large-cap, a commodity/resources name our uk-eu universes typically exclude since the bot targets firm-specific catalysts, not macro/FX-driven commodity selloffs.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a commodity_beta_proxy gate for LSE miners keyed off LME copper futures (e.g. flag names when copper moves >2% intraday) so macro-driven commodity-equity moves like today's dollar-strength selloff get surfaced for review.

top_movers.catalyst: JPMorgan downgraded STLA to Neutral (PT cut €10→€6) on Jul 9 citing cost-savings delayed to FY27/28; adds to HSBC's Reduce call on bloated US dealer inventory (93 days) and 2.5M-unit recalls.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — a large-cap Dutch-domiciled, dual-listed (NYSE/Euronext) auto OEM likely falls outside a uk-eu book scoped to UK/EU-domiciled names or excluding the autos sector, so no filter ever saw it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add STLA/STLAP.PA (and peer EU autos) to the uk-eu universe with a sell-side-downgrade trigger: flag when ≥2 analyst rating cuts hit within 5 trading days, independent of index/domicile screens.
